about_the_game:
Star Legion is a cooperative top-down shooter set in a distant future, where humanity, unified under a reborn Roman Empire, enters a new era of interstellar expansion.

You are a Legionary, an elite warrior assigned to carry out raids across entire sectors of the galaxy. Your objective: conquer worlds, eliminate robotic threats, and spread the glory of the Empire.

⚔️ Tactical incursions on hostile planets

Each sector represents a new battlefield. On enemy ground, you’ll face robotic forces — war machines left behind by extinct civilizations, now out of control. These units respond with precision and aggression, defending strategic facilities with lethal force.

👥 Local co-op

Enter combat alongside a friend with local cooperative mode. Divide tasks, choose complementary equipment, and overcome mechanical threats together. Tactical support is essential for success during incursions.

🛠️ Craft, prepare, and risk it all

Before each mission, you can build your own loadout. Choose from primary weapons, support gear, and tactical tools.
But beware: if you fail the mission, you’ll lose the gear you brought with you — meaning you’ll need to rebuild it before trying again.

🌌 Conquer a sector for the Empire

Each completed mission strengthens the Empire’s presence in the sector, revealing new targets and challenges. The campaign progresses dynamically, requiring you to adapt, improve your strategy, and prove your worth as the Empire’s armed hand among the stars.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 or Radeon Vega 6
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Star Legion is a local co-op top-down shooter where you battle rogue machines in intense missions. Craft gear, survive hostile incursions, and reclaim sectors to spread the glory of the intergalactic Roman Empire.
